authorization_source: The S03 user directive explicitly requests whether entity-harmed cases are the same events whose context margins improve.
scope: Descriptive event-set overlap only, computed from the already-authorized paired event ledger fields; no new model, feature, event, margin, threshold, or significance test.

definitions.context_margin_improved: event is in the context-primary slice and final_position target margin minus mean_full target margin is strictly positive
definitions.entity_harmed_correctness: event is in the entity-comparator slice, mean_full is correct, and final_position is incorrect
definitions.overlap: event_id intersection of the two sets above
definitions.shared_event_cross_table: within events belonging to both slices, cross-tab target-margin delta sign against the paired correctness transition

interpretation_limit: This is an event-identity overlap description. Since target margin and prediction are shared event-level quantities, it is not a causal effect or an independent context-versus-entity intervention.
